issuing_authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
mandate_context: SEBI Investor Education & Protection Advisory against Unregistered Digital Trading Platforms

attack_phases.name: Social Media Hook
tactics: Flaunting luxury lifestyle (sports cars, luxury watches, cash stacks)
Deepfake synthetic endorsements of respected business figures (e.g. Narayana Murthy, Mukesh Ambani)
Invitation to private VIP / Institutional trading channels

attack_phases.name: Trust Grooming & Authority Camouflage
tactics: Forging official SEBI RIA/RA registration certificates with manipulated names
Cloning identities and brand logos of top registered brokers (e.g., Zerodha, ICICI Direct)
Displaying fake corporate CIN / MCA incorporation records
Shill community members (bots / accomplices) thanking administrators for massive gains

attack_phases.name: The Unregistered App Trap
tactics: Instructing victims to bypass Google Play Protect or Apple App Store restrictions
Routing initial deposits into personal UPI handles (@okaxis, @ybl, @paytm) or mule current accounts
Absence of SEBI/NSE/BSE exchange trade confirmation SMS or UCC verification

attack_phases.name: Simulated Virtual Profits & Dopamine Loop
tactics: Simulating massive 500% to 1000% gains on fictitious trading dashboards
Permitting a token micro-withdrawal (e.g., ₹1,000 to ₹5,000) to build total trust
Coaching victim to liquidate mutual funds, provident funds, or take personal loans

attack_phases.name: Extortion, Withdrawal Freeze & Exit
tactics: Demanding upfront 'Capital Gains Tax' or 'SEBI Clearance Fee' (typically 20-30%)
Threatening legal prosecution or freezing of PAN card if payment is withheld
Deleting the Telegram group, changing UPI handles, and re-approaching victim as a 'cyber recovery agent'

sebi_prescribed_countermeasures.action: Always cross-verify intermediary registration number (INZ/INA/INH) on sebi.gov.in before any transaction.
Brokers are legally prohibited from collecting investor funds in personal UPI IDs or unrelated bank accounts.
Never install .apk packages shared via chat apps; only trade through verified developer listings on official app stores.
Ensure all executed trades trigger official daily SMS/email confirmations directly from NSE, BSE, or CDSL/NSDL.
